name: Build a volunteer induction checklist
why: Turns volunteer roles and rules into an induction procedure with sign-offs, a supervised practice plan and supervision gaps.

name: Volunteer induction evidence review assistant
why: Checks each volunteer's induction records against their role and lists what is missing, without clearing anyone.

name: Honest appreciation note writer
why: Writes a short thank-you with one true detail and no ask, the core of volunteer and member thanks.

name: Follow-up email sequence writer
why: Builds reminders with a new reason each time, send timing and a stop rule, the shape of a renewal set.

name: Rough notes to minutes writer
why: Turns a secretary's rough notes into short minutes with decisions, owners and dates.

name: Weekly meeting actions keeper
why: Keeps committee actions moving between meetings and drafts the next agenda with late items first.

name: Run a meeting worth holding, from agenda to action items
why: Helps a committee decide which meetings to hold and turn each one into owned actions.

name: Weekly newsletter keeper
why: Drafts and checks each member newsletter issue from the club's notes, in the club's voice.

name: Make a new policy understandable to staff
why: Explains a new club rule or volunteer policy in plain words, with an announcement and a rollout list.

name: Prepare a community event access plan
why: Plans who does what at a volunteer-run community event, from arrival to exit.
